name: Under the Canopy
question: Who persists in the shade they create?
expectedObservationsText: Twenty Raftballs and thirty Sunbeads scattered on a nutrient patch in fixed light. Raftballs float as a canopy that shades the cells under them, so algae beneath a Raftball get less light. Nothing here decides who persists: watch the light and the counts. Diverse Founders: a few founders may start with an extra ability, present at creation.
